page.overview:
Who is Web Kids?

The Web Kids are minor characters in A Bug's Life.

"Whee! Do it again, Dim! As the ants celebrate the completion of the bird, Dim gives the kids a real fun fling by using his wings to flip them onto Rosie's sticky web."

After the completion of the fake bird, everyone decides to throw a party. Dim and Rosie decided to build a target made out of sticky spider web for the kids to play with. While Rosie is talking to an ant about his 12th husband's death and that she's now a widow, Dim slingshots one of the kids with his wings. The kid (almost) successfully hits the bullseye of the target. The other kids are proud of him.
